description: Place the order: moves a `draft` or `suggested` order to `sent` and, when asked, EMAILS IT TO THE SUPPLIER. ASK THE MERCHANT WHETHER TO EMAIL, EVERY TIME, and only then pass sendEmail: true — that message leaves the platform and cannot be recalled. Default is false, which records the order as placed without mailing anything: the right choice when they ordered by phone, in person, or through the supplier’s own portal. Emailing needs a contactEmail on the supplier; without one, send with sendEmail: false and tell them why. The email carries the order in its body — this tool cannot attach the PO PDF the cabinet produces. After sending, the order can no longer be edited; only receiving or cancelling remain.

purchaseOrderId.description: Purchase order id from get_purchase_orders — not a PO number

sendEmail.description: Email the supplier. Defaults to false — set true ONLY after the merchant said to send it

name: hub_send_purchase_order
title: Send purchase order to supplier
